{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Tx4b3SFFAAem69pdTuGMrt","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing System.Text;\n2\tusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\n3\tusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n4\t\n5\tnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n6\t\n7\t/// <summary>\n8\t/// A decorator <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> that keeps a plan's <c>diagram.html</c> reflecting the\n9\t/// run's live progress (issue #219), mirroring <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s shape. It\n10\t/// WRAPS the real observer, forwards every event verbatim, and after certain events re-renders the\n11\t/// diagram from an in-memory per-node status map via <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>'s\n12\t/// optional <c>nodeStatuses</c> parameter (02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer):\n13\t/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n14\t///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/> the task's CONTAINER node flips to <c>\"running\"</c>\n15\t///     (coarse — per-check granularity for a task's own checks is unnecessary here since they have\n16\t///     not run yet; it is driven by <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> instead).</item>\n17\t///   <item>On <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> only the SPECIFIC preflight/guardrail leaf node that\n18\t///     just finished flips to <c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c> — never the whole task container.</item>\n19\t///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> the task's container flips to its settled status\n20\t///     (<c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c>/<c>\"needs-human\"</c>, mapped from <see cref=\"TaskOutcome\"/>).</item>\n21\t/// </list>\n22\t///\n23\t/// <para>\n24\t/// <b>Design choice (this task's either/or):</b> the Mermaid source, its source hash, and the\n25\t/// task-folder-targets map are threaded straight through the constructor — the same values the\n26\t/// caller (mirroring <c>GraphCommand</c>'s <c>MermaidRenderer.RenderInteractive</c> /\n27\t/// <c>TaskFolderTargets</c> calls) already computes from the live <c>PlanDefinition</c> — rather\n28\t/// than re-parsing them back out of the already-written <c>diagram.html</c>'s embedded\n29\t/// <c>&lt;script&gt;</c> tags. Threading is simpler and avoids a fragile round-trip through HTML/JSON\n30\t/// that would break the moment the embedded markup's shape changes for an unrelated reason.\n31\t/// </para>\n32\t///\n33\t/// <para>\n34\t/// <b>Node-id scheme.</b> <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/>'s injective task-id → node-id-base\n35\t/// allocation (collision-safe sanitize + <c>_2</c>/<c>_3</c>… disambiguation) is <c>private</c>, so\n36\t/// this class reproduces it character-for-character (see <see cref=\"AllocateNodeIdBases\"/> /\n37\t/// <see cref=\"Sanitize\"/>) to compute the SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) and leaf ids\n38\t/// (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;_pf_&lt;n&gt;</c> / <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;n&gt;</c>, <c>n</c> = the\n39\t/// check's ordinal position when its task's <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>/\n40\t/// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> are sorted ordinal by <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/>,\n41\t/// exactly as <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c> emits them) that <c>diagram.html</c> already\n42\t/// embeds, so a status badge lands on the right SVG node.\n43\t/// </para>\n44\t///\n45\t/// <para>\n46\t/// This decorator's own status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads may call\n47\t/// in concurrently, so all access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under\n48\t/// one lock, mirroring <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>. Renders are best-effort: a render\n49\t/// failure (e.g. a transient file lock, or a bad output path) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n50\t/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n51\t/// </para>\n52\t///\n53\t/// <para>\n54\t/// <b>MINIMAL STUB (this task authors failing tests only).</b> <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> always\n55\t/// throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> — the real re-render (calling\n56\t/// <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> and writing it to <c>diagram.html</c>) is\n57\t/// <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c>'s job. System.Text;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Execution;\nusing Guardrails.Core.Model;\n\nnamespace Guardrails.Cli.Ui;\n\n/// <summary>\n/// A decorator <see cref=\"IRunObserver\"/> that keeps a plan's It\n/// WRAPS the real observer, forwards every event verbatim, and after certain events re-renders the\n/// diagram from an in-memory per-node status map via <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/>'s\n/// optional <c>nodeStatuses</c> parameter (02-implement-diagram-status-overlay-renderer):\n/// <list type=\"bullet\">\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskStarting\"/> the task's CONTAINER node flips to <c>\"running\"</c>\n///     (coarse — per-check granularity for a task's own checks is unnecessary here since they have\n///     not run yet; it is driven by <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> instead).</item>\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"GuardrailFinished\"/> only the SPECIFIC preflight/guardrail leaf node that\n///     just finished flips to <c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c> — never the whole task container.</item>\n///   <item>On <see cref=\"TaskFinished\"/> the task's container flips to its settled status\n///     (<c>\"passed\"</c>/<c>\"failed\"</c>/<c>\"needs-human\"</c>, mapped from <see cref=\"TaskOutcome\"/>).</item>\n/// </list>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Design choice (this task's either/or):</b> the Mermaid source, its source hash, and the\n/// task-folder-targets map are threaded straight through the constructor — the same values the\n/// caller (mirroring <c>GraphCommand</c>'s <c>MermaidRenderer.RenderInteractive</c> /\n/// <c>TaskFolderTargets</c> calls) already computes from the live <c>PlanDefinition</c> — rather\n/// than re-parsing them back out of the already-written <c>diagram.html</c>'s embedded\n/// <c>&lt;script&gt;</c> tags. Threading is simpler and avoids a fragile round-trip through HTML/JSON\n/// that would break the moment the embedded markup's shape changes for an unrelated reason.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>Node-id scheme.</b> <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/>'s injective task-id → node-id-base\n/// allocation (collision-safe sanitize + <c>_2</c>/<c>_3</c>… disambiguation) is <c>private</c>, so\n/// this class reproduces it character-for-character (see <see cref=\"AllocateNodeIdBases\"/> /\n/// <see cref=\"Sanitize\"/>) to compute the SAME container id (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>) and leaf ids\n/// (<c>task_&lt;base&gt;_pf_&lt;n&gt;</c> / <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;n&gt;</c>, <c>n</c> = the\n/// check's ordinal position when its task's <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>/\n/// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> are sorted ordinal by <see cref=\"GuardrailDefinition.Name\"/>,\n/// exactly as <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c> emits them) that <c>diagram.html</c> already\n/// embeds, so a status badge lands on the right SVG node.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// This decorator's own status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads may call\n/// in concurrently, so all access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under\n/// one lock, mirroring <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>. Renders are best-effort: a render\n/// failure (e.g. a transient file lock, or a bad output path) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.\n/// </para>\n///\n/// <para>\n/// <b>MINIMAL STUB (this task authors failing tests only).</b> <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> always\n/// throws <see cref=\"NotImplementedException\"/> — the real re-render (calling\n/// <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> and writing it to <c>diagram.html</c>) is\n/// <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c>'s job. Every status-map/node-id bookkeeping method above is\n/// real (not stubbed) so the authored tests encode the CORRECT expected node ids/statuses and turn\n/// green the moment <see cref=\"WriteDiagram\"/> is implemented for real.\n/// </para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyDiagramObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly string _diagramHtmlPath;\n    private readonly string _mermaidSource;\n    private readonly string _sourceHash;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _taskFolderTargets;\n\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> _nodeIdBaseByTaskId;\n\n    // Per-node status word (container + leaf check ids). Mutated and projected under one lock —\n    // events may arrive from concurrent M4 workers, and the render reads the whole map, so the two\n    // must not race (mirrors OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver's _gate).\n    private readonly object _gate = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByNode = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks — used to resolve container/leaf node ids.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"diagramHtmlPath\">The plan's <c>diagram.html</c> path, re-rendered in place.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"mermaidSource\">\n    /// The interactive Mermaid source (<c>MermaidRenderer.RenderInteractive</c>'s output) to re-embed\n    /// on every re-render — identical to what <c>diagram.html</c> already carries.\n    /// </param>\n    /// <param name=\"sourceHash\">The plan's <c>source-sha256</c> provenance stamp.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"taskFolderTargets\">\n    /// The task-container-id → plan-relative-folder-path map (<c>MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets</c>)\n    /// the title-band click overlay needs, re-embedded unchanged on every re-render.\n    /// </param>\n    public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver(\n        IRunObserver inner,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        string diagramHtmlPath,\n        string mermaidSource,\n        string sourceHash,\n        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> taskFolderTargets)\n    {\n        _inner = inner ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(inner));\n        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(tasks);\n        _diagramHtmlPath = diagramHtmlPath ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(diagramHtmlPath));\n        _mermaidSource = mermaidSource ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(mermaidSource));\n        _sourceHash = sourceHash ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceHash));\n        _taskFolderTargets = taskFolderTargets ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(taskFolderTargets));\n\n        _tasksById = tasks.ToDictionary(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        _nodeIdBaseByTaskId = AllocateNodeIdBases(tasks);\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(ContainerId(task), \"running\");\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n        string? nodeId = ResolveCheckNodeId(task, result.Name);\n        if (nodeId is not null)\n        {\n            SetStatus(nodeId, result.Passed ? \"passed\" : \"failed\");\n        }\n\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n        {\n            SetStatus(ContainerId(task), SettledStatusWord(result.Outcome));\n        }\n\n        Render();\n    }\n\n    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n\n    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n\n    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n\n    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n\n    // --- status-map bookkeeping -------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void SetStatus(string nodeId, string status)\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            _statusByNode[nodeId] = status;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Rewrite <c>diagram.html</c> from the current status map. Holds the lock for the whole render\n    /// so the status snapshot is internally consistent. Best-effort via <see cref=\"TryRender\"/>.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void Render()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            var snapshot = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByNode, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => WriteDiagram(snapshot));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// MINIMAL STUB (issue #219 wiring): the real re-render — call\n    /// <see cref=\"HtmlDiagramRenderer.Render\"/> with <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> and atomically\n    /// write the result to <see cref=\"_diagramHtmlPath\"/> — is <c>04-implement-diagram-observer</c>'s\n    /// job. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the\n    /// next event. Mirrors <see cref=\"OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver\"/>'s identical helper exactly.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a diagram-path permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n\n    // --- node-id resolution -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private string ContainerId(TaskNode task) => $\"task_{_nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id]}\";\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Resolve a finished check's specific leaf node id: <paramref name=\"checkName\"/> is looked up\n    /// first against <paramref name=\"task\"/>'s <see cref=\"TaskNode.Preflights\"/>, then its\n    /// <see cref=\"TaskNode.Guardrails\"/> (both sorted ordinal by name, mirroring\n    /// <c>MermaidRenderer.AppendCheckNodes</c>'s emission order) — so a task-level preflight and a\n    /// guardrail are never confused even if their names happened to collide. Returns null\n    /// (defensive — never set a status for an unrecognized check) when no check matches.\n    /// </summary>\n    private string? ResolveCheckNodeId(TaskNode task, string checkName)\n    {\n        string @base = _nodeIdBaseByTaskId[task.Id];\n\n        int pfIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Preflights, checkName);\n        if (pfIndex >= 0)\n        {\n            return $\"task_{@base}_pf_{pfIndex}\";\n        }\n\n        int grIndex = IndexOfByName(task.Guardrails, checkName);\n        return grIndex >= 0 ? $\"task_{@base}_gr_{grIndex}\" : null;\n    }\n\n    private static int IndexOfByName(IReadOnlyList<GuardrailDefinition> checks, string name)\n    {\n        List<GuardrailDefinition> sorted = checks.OrderBy(c => c.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        for (int i = 0; i < sorted.Count; i++)\n        {\n            if (string.Equals(sorted[i].Name, name, StringComparison.Ordinal))\n            {\n                return i;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return -1;\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Map a finished task's outcome to one of the diagram's three settled status words — the\n    /// live/pending words (\"running\"/\"pending\") never apply here since the task has already\n    /// finished. <see \"needs-human\",\n        _ => \"failed\", // ActionFailed, GuardrailFailed, InvalidFragment, Blocked\n    };\n\n    // --- replicated from MermaidRenderer (private there) — see class remarks, \"Node-id scheme\" ---\n\n    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> AllocateNodeIdBases(IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks)\n    {\n        List<TaskNode> ordered = tasks.OrderBy(t => t.Id, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();\n        var bases = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n        var taken = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);\n\n        foreach (TaskNode task in ordered)\n        {\n            string candidate = Sanitize(task.Id);\n            if (!taken.Add(candidate))\n            {\n                int suffix = 2;\n                string disambiguated;\n                do\n                {\n                    disambiguated = $\"{candidate}_{suffix}\";\n                    suffix++;\n                }\n                while string Sanitize(string id)\n    {\n        var sb = new StringBuilder(id.Length);\n        foreach (char c in id)\n        {\n            bool safe = c is (>= 'a' and <= 'z') or (>= 'A' and <= 'Z') or This decorator's own\n/// status map is the only shared mutable state, and M4 worker threads call in concurrently, so all\n/// access to it — and the write that projects from it — is serialised under one lock. Renders are\n/// best-effort: a render failure (e.g. a transient file lock) is swallowed so a UX nicety never\n/// flips a task's outcome or aborts the run.</para>\n/// </summary>\npublic sealed class OnTheFlyLogSiteObserver : IRunObserver\n{\n    private readonly IRunObserver _inner;\n    private readonly string _logsRoot;\n    private readonly string _runId;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> _tasks;\n    private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TaskNode> _tasksById;\n    private readonly Func<string, string?>? _liveUrlForTask;\n\n    // Per-task status word, seeded \"pending\". Mutated and projected under one lock — events arrive\n    // from concurrent M4 workers, and the index render reads the whole map, so the two must not race.\n    private readonly object _gate = new();\n    private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _statusByTask;\n\n    /// <param name=\"inner\">The real observer every event is forwarded to (live or console).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the site is written into.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">\n    /// Resolver mapping a task id to its live-server URL, or null when no server is up. Best-effort. Any console write into an active Live region\n    /// corrupts the table, so the initial index + its static-index link must be emitted first (#145\n    /// Bug 1). Best-effort: a render failure is swallowed (a UX nicety never aborts the run).\n    /// </summary>\n    /// <param name=\"logsRoot\">The run's <c>logs/&lt;runId&gt;/</c> tree the index is written into.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"runId\">The run id (titles the rendered index).</param>\n    /// <param name=\"tasks\">The plan's tasks, in plan order — the rows of the index.</param>\n    /// <param name=\"liveUrlForTask\">Unused at the all-pending start (no task is running yet); accepted\n    /// so the static signature matches the instance's link-resolution surface for callers.</param>\n    public static void WriteInitialIndex(\n        string logsRoot,\n        string runId,\n        IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks,\n        Func<string, string?>? liveUrlForTask)\n    {\n        _ = liveUrlForTask; // no task is running at the all-pending start, so no live link is resolved yet\n        string pending = LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Pending);\n        TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n            logsRoot,\n            runId,\n            tasks,\n            statusResolver: _ => pending,\n            linkResolver: _ => LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain,\n            includeRefresh: true));\n    }\n\n    public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskStarting(task);\n        SetStatus(task.Id, LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running));\n        RenderIndex();\n    }\n\n    public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n        _inner.AttemptStarting(task, attempt, budget);\n\n    public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n        _inner.GuardrailFinished(task, result);\n\n    public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result)\n    {\n        _inner.TaskFinished(result);\n        SetStatus(result.TaskId, StatusWord(result.Outcome));\n\n        // Write the finished task's static page so the index's link to it (and the terminal's\n        // post-mortem link, #141 item 1) resolves to a rendered page, not a 404.\n        if (_tasksById.TryGetValue(result.TaskId, out TaskNode? task))\n        {\n            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteTaskPageIfHasAttempts(_logsRoot, task));\n        }\n\n        RenderIndex();\n    }\n\n    public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) => _inner.PlanHashMismatch(previousPlanHash);\n\n    public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) => _inner.ParallelismClampedNoProvider(requested);\n\n    public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) => _inner.CleanupFailed(owner, error);\n\n    public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n        _inner.PromptPaused(task, reason, backoff, pauseCount);\n\n    // --- site projection --------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n    private void SetStatus(string taskId, string status)\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            _statusByTask[taskId] = status;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Rewrite the during-run index (with refresh) from the current status map. Holds the lock for the\n    /// whole render so the status snapshot and the link choice are consistent (the renderer writes\n    /// atomically). The link resolver: a RUNNING task → the live URL when a server is up (else plain),\n    /// any task with attempts on disk → its static page, anything else → plain text.\n    /// </summary>\n    private void RenderIndex()\n    {\n        lock (_gate)\n        {\n            // Snapshot the statuses inside the lock so the resolver closures read a stable view.\n            var statuses = new Dictionary<string, string>(_statusByTask, StringComparer.Ordinal);\n            TryRender(() => LogSiteRenderer.WriteIndex(\n                _logsRoot,\n                _runId,\n                _tasks,\n                statusResolver: id => statuses.TryGetValue(id, out string? s) ? s : \"unknown\",\n                linkResolver: id => ResolveLink(id, statuses),\n                includeRefresh: true));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink ResolveLink(string taskId, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> statuses)\n    {\n        bool running = statuses.TryGetValue(taskId, out string? status) &&\n                       status == LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Running);\n\n        // A running task links to the live server (a click tails it) when one is up; otherwise it is\n        // plain text (no static page to point at yet).\n        if (running && _liveUrlForTask?.Invoke(taskId) is { } liveUrl)\n        {\n            return LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.LiveTo(liveUrl);\n        }\n\n        // A task with attempts on disk (running-without-server, or settled) links to its static page;\n        // a pending/no-attempt task is plain text.\n        return HasAttempts(taskId) ? LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Static : LogSiteRenderer.IndexLink.Plain;\n    }\n\n    private bool HasAttempts(string taskId)\n    {\n        string taskDir = Path.Combine(_logsRoot, taskId);\n        if (!Directory.Exists(taskDir))\n        {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        return Directory.EnumerateDirectories(taskDir)\n            .Any(d => Path.GetFileName(d).StartsWith(\"attempt-\", StringComparison.Ordinal));\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>Map a finished task's outcome to the index status word (mirrors the journal mapping).</summary>\n    private static string StatusWord(TaskOutcome outcome) => outcome switch\n    {\n        TaskOutcome.Succeeded => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Succeeded),\n        TaskOutcome.Skipped => \"skipped\",\n        TaskOutcome.Blocked => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.Blocked),\n        TaskOutcome.Cancelled => \"cancelled\",\n        // ActionFailed / GuardrailFailed / InvalidFragment / NeedsHuman are all needs-human terminal.\n        _ => LogSiteRenderer.StatusText(Core.Journal.TaskStatus.NeedsHuman),\n    };\n\n    /// <summary>\n    /// Run a render action, swallowing IO failures: the on-the-fly site is a UX nicety and must never\n    /// flip a task's outcome or abort the run. A transient lock/torn-read is retried by the next event.\n    /// </summary>\n    private static void TryRender(Action render)\n    {\n        try\n        {\n            render();\n        }\n        catch (IOException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — the next event re-renders\n        }\n        catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)\n        {\n            // best-effort — never let a logs-tree permission hiccup abort the run\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":235,"startLine":1,"totalLines":235}}}

  private sealed class RecordingObserver : IRunObserver\n    {\n        public List<string> Events { get; } = [];\n\n        public void TaskStarting(TaskNode task) => Events.Add($\"TaskStarting:{task.Id}\");\n\n        public void AttemptStarting(TaskNode task, int attempt, int budget) =>\n            Events.Add($\"AttemptStarting:{task.Id}:{attempt}:{budget}\");\n\n        public void TaskFinished(TaskResult result) => Events.Add($\"TaskFinished:{result.TaskId}\");\n\n        public void GuardrailFinished(TaskNode task, GuardrailResult result) =>\n            Events.Add($\"GuardrailFinished:{task.Id}:{result.Name}\");\n\n        public void PlanHashMismatch(string previousPlanHash) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PlanHashMismatch:{previousPlanHash}\");\n\n        public void ParallelismClampedNoProvider(int requested) =>\n            Events.Add($\"ParallelismClampedNoProvider:{requested}\");\n\n        public void CleanupFailed(string owner, Exception error) =>\n            Events.Add($\"CleanupFailed:{owner}:{error.Message}\");\n\n        public void PromptPaused(TaskNode task, string reason, TimeSpan backoff, int pauseCount) =>\n            Events.Add($\"PromptPaused:{task.Id}:{reason}:{(int)backoff.TotalSeconds}:{pauseCount}\");\n    }\n\n    /// <summary>A throwaway plan-shaped directory tree, entirely under the OS temp root, with\n    /// helpers to build fixtures and construct the observer/read its output — mirrors\n    /// <c>OnTheFlyLogSiteTests.TempSite</c>. Every path this class hands out is rooted under\n    /// <see cref=\"Dir\"/>, so no test in this file can ever write outside its own throwaway tree.</summary>\n    private sealed class TempSite : IDisposable\n    {\n        public string Dir { get; } = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), \"gr-otf-diagram-\" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString(\"N\"));\n\n        public string DiagramHtmlPath => Path.Combine(Dir, \"diagram.html\");\n\n        public string MermaidSource { get; } = \"flowchart TD\\n  task_01_root[\\\"01-root\\\"]\\n\";\n\n        public string SourceHash { get; } = \"deadbeef\";\n\n        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> TaskFolderTargets { get; } =\n            new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal) { [\"task_01_root\"] = \"tasks/01-root/\" };\n\n        public TempSite() => Directory.CreateDirectory(Dir);\n\n        public TaskNode Task(string id, IReadOnlyList<string>? guardrailNames = null)\n        {\n            IReadOnlyList<string> names = guardrailNames ?? [\"01-check\"];\n            return new TaskNode\n            {\n                Id = id,\n                Directory = Path.Combine(Dir, \"tasks\", id),\n                Description = \"task \" + id,\n                Action = new ActionDefinition { Path = \"action.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script },\n                Guardrails = names\n                    .Select(n => new GuardrailDefinition { Name = n, Path = $\"{n}.ps1\", Kind = ActionKind.Script })\n                    .ToList(),\n            };\n        }\n\n        public OnTheFlyDiagramObserver Observer(IRunObserver inner, IReadOnlyList<TaskNode> tasks) =>\n            new(inner, tasks, DiagramHtmlPath, MermaidSource, SourceHash, TaskFolderTargets);\n\n        public string ReadDiagram() => File.ReadAllText(DiagramHtmlPath);\n\n        public void Dispose()\n        {\n            try { Directory.Delete(Dir, recursive: true); } catch (Exception) { /* best effort */ }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","numLines":211,"startLine":1,"totalLines":211}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MuM4sLBwfCHkGmhD1pjY9E","type":"tool_result","content":"1\tusing System.Text.Encodings.Web;\n2\tusing System.Text.Json;\n3\t\n4\tnamespace Guardrails.Core.Graph;\n5\t\n6\t/// <summary>\n7\t/// Renders the local-viewing companion to <c>diagram.md</c>: a self-contained\n8\t/// <c>diagram.html</c> that displays the SAME Mermaid DAG with pan / zoom / fullscreen, so a\n9\t/// large task+guardrail graph is actually navigable on disk (GitHub renders <c>diagram.md</c>\n10\t/// but offers no navigation). Pure: maps the rendered Mermaid text + its <c>source-sha256</c>\n11\t/// to an HTML string with no I/O (issue #33).\n12\t/// </summary>\n13\t/// <remarks>\n14\t/// <para>\n15\t/// The Mermaid source is embedded VERBATIM as the text content of a\n16\t/// <c>&lt;script type=\"text/plain\"&gt;</c> element and read back via <c>textContent</c> — never\n17\t/// interpolated into a JS string. This sidesteps every escaping hazard (a label containing a\n18\t/// backtick, <c>${</c>, or a quote cannot break the page), and a <c>&lt;script&gt;</c> element's\n19\t/// content is \"raw text\" so entities are not decoded — the source round-trips byte-for-byte.\n20\t/// This is safe because <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> HTML-escapes every label (so <c>&lt;</c>\n21\t/// becomes <c>&amp;lt;</c>), meaning the source can never contain <c>&lt;/script&gt;</c>.\n22\t/// </para>\n23\t/// <para>\n24\t/// The <c>source-sha256</c> provenance comment is emitted as the FIRST line (before\n25\t/// <c>&lt;!doctype html&gt;</c>) so the same <c>\\A</c>-anchored reader that validates\n26\t/// <c>diagram.md</c> validates this file too (<c>graph --check</c>). A comment before the\n27\t/// doctype does not trigger quirks mode.\n28\t/// </para>\n29\t/// <para>\n30\t/// The renderer (Mermaid) and pan-zoom library load from a CDN, so the interactive view needs\n31\t/// internet the first time. GitHub will not execute the embedded script — this file is the\n32\t/// LOCAL artifact; <c>diagram.md</c> remains the portal artifact. Fully offline (inlined assets)\n33\t/// is a possible follow-up.\n34\t/// </para>\n35\t/// <para>\n36\t/// <b>Legend overlay.</b> A corner-anchored <c>#legend</c> <c>&lt;div&gt;</c>\n37\t/// (<c>position: fixed</c>), mirroring the existing <c>#bar</c>/<c>#hint</c> overlay divs, renders\n38\t/// <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.LegendMarkdown\"/>'s content OUTSIDE the Mermaid SVG. A Mermaid-native\n39\t/// legend (a disconnected subgraph of colour-swatch nodes) was prototyped and rendered BROKEN —\n40\t/// dagre lays out a disconnected subgraph as a phantom extra \"task\" overlapping the real DAG — so\n41\t/// the overlay div is the only approach that renders correctly. Static HTML, not templated from\n42\t/// the Mermaid source, so it carries no bearing on <c>source-sha256</c>.\n43\t/// </para>\n44\t/// <para>\n45\t/// <b>Task-container click target: a POST-RENDER SVG title-band overlay (issue #232/#233\n46\t/// superseded, issue #235).</b> A Mermaid <c>click</c> directive never fires on a subgraph/cluster\n47\t/// element (upstream limitation; see <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> remarks), and the first fix\n48\t/// attempt — an invisible anchor NODE inside the container — proved useless in practice: dagre\n49\t/// sizes and packs it into whatever gap its own layout leaves, which for a content-dense container\n50\t/// is a tiny, off-center sliver (measured: 0.44% of the container's area on a real 4-guardrail\n51\t/// task). The fix implemented here instead runs AFTER <c>mermaid.render</c> resolves: for every\n52\t/// <c>g.cluster</c> element whose id starts with <c>task_</c>, compute a full-width band from the\n53\t/// cluster's own bounding box down to just past its <c>.cluster-label</c>'s bottom edge (Mermaid\n54\t/// always reserves this header strip above any leaf content, so it is empty BY CONSTRUCTION\n55\t/// regardless of how many guardrails/preflights the task has — unlike an interior anchor node) and\n56\t/// append a real <c>&lt;a href=\"...\" target=\"_blank\"&gt;&lt;rect fill=\"transparent\"&gt;&lt;/a&gt;</c>\n57\t/// spanning it. APPENDED, not inserted first: a cluster's only two original children are its\n58\t/// background <c>&lt;rect&gt;</c> then its <c>.cluster-label</c> group, so appending puts the\n59\t/// overlay last in paint order (on top, clickable) without moving in front of the label text\n60\t/// visually (the rect is transparent) and — because every leaf check node lives in an entirely\n61\t/// separate top-level SVG group from its own container's <c>g.cluster</c> — the overlay can never\n62\t/// occlude or be occluded by a leaf node's own click target either way. The task→folder-path data\n63\t/// this script needs (<see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>) is embedded as a small JSON\n64\t/// object keyed by the SAME container id the Mermaid source uses, in a\n65\t/// <c>&lt;script type=\"application/json\"&gt;</c> element read back via <c>textContent</c> (same\n66\t/// verbatim/never-interpolated treatment as the Mermaid source itself, immune to the same escaping\n67\t/// hazards).\n68\t/// </para>\n69\t/// <para>\n70\t/// <b>Long task-name title wrap-overflow, fixed by widening the label's foreignObject\n71\t/// post-render (issue cluster-label-wrap-overflow).</b> Mermaid always wraps a cluster's title\n72\t/// <c>&lt;div&gt;</c> to a hardcoded 200px width (the bundled <c>mermaid@11.4.1</c>'s plain\n73\t/// flowchart cluster shape never overrides <c>createText</c>'s <c>width = 200</c> default,\n74\t/// regardless of the container's own — usually much wider — computed width), and dagre's layout\n75\t/// pass reserves the container's header-strip height BEFORE that wrapped height is known, so a\n76\t/// long kebab-case task name (hyphens are valid soft line-break points) that wraps to 2+ lines\n77\t/// prints past the reserved strip, overlapping the first leaf guardrail/preflight box positioned\n78\t/// directly below. No Mermaid config knob avoids this — <c>flowchart.htmlLabels</c> only toggles\n79\t/// the html-vs-svg-text label renderer, and 11.4.1 has no documented option for cluster-label\n80\t/// wrap width. The fix (the <c>fixWrappedClusterLabels</c> function, run AFTER\n81\t/// <c>mermaid.render</c> resolves and BEFORE the title-band overlay above, since the overlay's\n82\t/// band height depends on the label's — by then possibly shrunk — bounding box) re-wraps the\n83\t/// SAME text at up to the container's own width instead: since the container is normally already\n84\t/// wider than 200px, this almost always drops the label to one line, which needs LESS height than\n85\t/// the original wrap — never more — so no other node/edge/container ever needs to move. Verified\n86\t/// headless against 8+ real plans (40+ long task names): every wrapped case converged to one line\n87\t/// with the same healthy gap a never-wrapped label already has, and every already-fits label\n88\t/// (including the whole golden <c>hello-guardrails</c> example) was left byte-for-byte unchanged.\n89\t/// </para>\n90\t/// <para>\n91\t/// <b>Search box (issue #220).</b> A fixed-position <c>#search-box</c> <c>&lt;div&gt;</c> (same\n92\t/// overlay technique as <c>#legend</c>/<c>#bar</c>/<c>#hint</c> and the status badges) is emitted\n93\t/// UNCONDITIONALLY — unlike the live status overlay above, search does not depend on the\n94\t/// <c>nodeStatuses</c> parameter (see <see cref=\"Render\"/>) being non-null, so it is present on both\n95\t/// the static <c>graph</c> output and the live/final run diagrams. The search-matching data (every\n96\t/// node id + visible label) is embedded the same way as\n97\t/// <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/> — a <c>&lt;script type=\"application/json\"\n98\t/// id=\"search-index\"&gt;</c> side-table read back via <c>textContent</c> — built by\n99\t/// <see cref=\"BuildSearchIndexJson\"/>. <b>This is a stub</b>: it always emits an empty object, and\n100\t/// the embedded <c>runSearch</c> script throws (a deliberate TDD red for\n101\t/// <c>08-implement-diagram-search-box</c>) — see that method's remarks.\n102\t/// </para>\n103\t/// </remarks>\n104\tpublic static class HtmlDiagramRenderer\n105\t{\n106\t    /// <summary>\n107\t    /// Build the <c>diagram.html</c> document for <paramref name=\"mermaidSource\"/> (the exact\n108\t    /// text rendered into <c>diagram.md</c>, including the <c>flowchart TD</c> header and the\n109\t    /// cosmetic <c>classDef</c> lines) stamped with <paramref name=\"sourceHash\"/>. <paramref\n110\t    /// name=\"taskFolderTargets\"/> is the task-container-id → plan-relative-folder-path map (see\n111\t    /// <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer.TaskFolderTargets\"/>) the embedded title-band overlay script uses\n112\t    /// to resolve each container's click target (issue #235 — see class remarks).\n113\t    /// </summary>\n114\t    /// <param name=\"nodeStatuses\">\n115\t    /// OPTIONAL live-run status map (issue #219): Mermaid node/container id → one of\n116\t    /// <c>\"pending\"</c>, <c>\"running\"</c>, <c>\"passed\"</c>, <c>\"failed\"</c>, <c>\"needs-human\"</c>,\n117\t    /// keyed by the SAME ids <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/> emits (task containers <c>task_&lt;base&gt;</c>,\n118\t    /// preflight/guardrail leaves <c>task_&lt;base&gt;_pf_&lt;n&gt;</c>/<c>task_&lt;base&gt;_gr_&lt;n&gt;</c>,\n119\t    /// and the plan-level brackets <c>plan_preflights</c>/<c>plan_guardrails</c>). When non-null the\n120\t    /// document additionally carries a per-node status-overlay badge (an animated spinner while\n121\t    /// <c>running</c>, a settled check/X/\"?\" glyph once finished). When <c>null</c> (the static\n122\t    /// <c>graph</c> command, which never runs live) the output is byte-identical to the pre-#219\n123\t    /// three-argument render.\n124\t    /// </param>\n125\t    /// <param name=\"includeRefresh\">\n126\t    /// INDEPENDENT of the status overlay (mirrors <c>LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)</c>):\n127\t    /// when <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> is non-null AND this is <c>true</c> (the default,\n128\t    /// the DURING-RUN diagram) a <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\" content=\"2\"&gt;</c> is emitted so a\n129\t    /// plain <c>file://</c> view re-reads itself as the run progresses; when <c>false</c> (the FINAL\n130\t    /// settled render wired at run-end by <c>06-wire-diagramobserver-into-runcommand</c>) the overlay\n131\t    /// is still emitted but the refresh tag is not. Ignored when <paramref name=\"nodeStatuses\"/> is null.\n132\t    /// </param>\n133\t    public static string Render(\n134\t        string mermaidSource, string sourceHash, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> taskFolderTargets,\n135\t        IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string>? nodeStatuses = null, bool includeRefresh = true)\n136\t    {\n137\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(mermaidSource);\n138\t        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(sourceHash);\n139\t        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(taskFolderTargets);\n140\t\n141\t        // Newline-normalize so the file is byte-identical across OSes (mirrors the renderer/hash).\n142\t        string source = mermaidSource\n143\t            .Replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n144\t            .Replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n145\t            .TrimEnd('\\n');\n146\t\n147\t        // Encoder that escapes NOTHING beyond what JSON strictly requires (default System.Text.Json\n148\t        // escapes '<', '>', '&', etc. as \\uXXXX for HTML safety, which is unnecessary here — the\n149\t        // JSON sits inside a <script type=\"application/json\"> element, read back via textContent,\n150\t        // exactly like the Mermaid source above — but using the unsafe-relaxed encoder keeps a\n151\t        // task-id containing e.g. \"&\" readable in the raw HTML source without changing behavior).\n152\t        string targetsJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(taskFolderTargets, new JsonSerializerOptions\n153\t        {\n154\t            Encoder = JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping,\n155\t        });\n156\t\n157\t        // Search box (issue #220) is UNCONDITIONAL — unlike the status overlay below, it does not\n158\t html = Template\n162\t            .Replace(\"__SOURCE_SHA256__\", sourceHash, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n163\t            .Replace(\"__GRAPH_SOURCE__\", source, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n164\t            .Replace(\"__TASK_FOLDER_TARGETS__\", targetsJson, StringComparison.Ordinal)\n165\t            .Replace(\"__SEARCH_INDEX__\", searchIndexJson, StringComparison.Ordinal);\n166\t\n167\t        // Live-run status overlay (issue #219) is OPTIONAL: when nodeStatuses is null (the static\n168\t        // `graph` command, which never runs live) the template is emitted UNCHANGED, so the output\n169\t        // stays byte-identical to the pre-#219 three-argument render. When provided, inject the\n170\t        // per-node status badges + CSS, the node-statuses side-table, and — when includeRefresh — the\n171\t        // auto-reload meta tag (see InjectStatusOverlay).\n172\t        if (nodeStatuses is not null)\n173\t        {\n174\t            html = InjectStatusOverlay(html, nodeStatuses, includeRefresh);\n175\t        }\n176\t\n177\t        // Normalize the full output — the template raw-string literal (and the injected blocks above)\n178\t        // pick up \\r\\n when the file is checked out with CRLF on Windows; the mermaid source is\n179\t        // already normalized above.\n180\t        return html\n181\t            .Replace(\"\\r\\n\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal)\n182\t            .Replace(\"\\r\", \"\\n\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n183\t    }\n184\t\n185\t    /// <summary>\n186\t    /// Build the diagram-search (issue #220) id-to-label side-table embedded as\n187\t    /// <c>__SEARCH_INDEX__</c>, mirroring the <c>__TASK_FOLDER_TARGETS__</c> JSON side-table (see\n188\t    /// class remarks, \"Search box\"). <c>08-implement-diagram-search-box</c> will parse <paramref\n189\t    /// name=\"mermaidSource\"/> for every node/container id and its visible label — the SAME\n190\t    /// <c>id[label]</c> shapes <see cref=\"MermaidRenderer\"/>'s <c>AppendTaskContainer</c>/\n191\t    /// <c>AppendCheckNodes</c> emit (task containers, preflight/guardrail leaves, and the two\n192\t    /// plan-level brackets) — into real id-&gt;label entries.\n193\t    /// </summary>\n194\t    /// <remarks>\n195\t    /// <b>STUB (deliberate TDD red).</b> This task (<c>07-author-tests-diagram-search-box</c>)\n196\t    /// authors the failing tests and the minimal search-box wiring only — it always returns an empty\n197\t    /// object regardless of <paramref name=\"mermaidSource\"/>, so the search box never actually finds\n198\t    /// a match until the real parsing lands. Returning <c>\"{}\"</c> rather than throwing keeps every\n199\t    /// existing <see cref=\"Render\"/> call (including every pre-existing golden/round-trip fixture)\n200\t    /// working unchanged — only the search-specific tests that assert the index is POPULATED are\n201\t    /// meant to fail against this stub.\n202\t    /// </remarks>\n203\t    private static string BuildSearchIndexJson(string mermaidSource) => \"{}\";\n204\t\n205\t    /// <summary>\n206\t    /// Inject the live-run status overlay (issue #219) into the base <paramref name=\"html\"/>: the\n207\t    /// per-node status-badge markup + CSS, the <c>#node-statuses</c> JSON side-table, and — when\n208\t    /// <paramref name=\"includeRefresh\"/> — the <c>&lt;meta http-equiv=\"refresh\"&gt;</c> auto-reload\n209\t    /// tag. Called ONLY on the non-null path (see <see cref=\"Render\"/>), so the static-graph output is\n210\t    /// left byte-identical.\n211\t    /// </summary>\n212\t    /// <remarks>\n213\t    /// Mirrors the existing title-band overlay's post-render-script technique: the badges are HTML\n214\t    /// overlay <c>&lt;div&gt;</c>s (like <c>#bar</c>/<c>#legend</c>) rendered OUTSIDE the SVG and\n215\t    /// anchored to each node's on-screen box via <c>getBoundingClientRect()</c>. Because they live in\n216\t    /// screen space rather than inside the SVG, they are re-anchored on every <c>svg-pan-zoom</c>\n217\t    /// pan/zoom (wired through the pan-zoom instance's <c>onPan</c>/<c>onZoom</c> callbacks) and on\n218\t    /// window resize. A <c>running</c> node shows an animated CSS-<c>@keyframes</c> spinner (no\n219\t    /// external image); every other (settled) status shows a static glyph. The auto-reload tag is\n220\t    /// INDEPENDENT of the overlay (mirrors <c>LogSiteRenderer.IndexHtml(..., includeRefresh)</c>'s\n221\t    /// during-run vs final duality) — present for the during-run diagram, dropped for the final\n222\t    /// settled render.\n223\t    /// </remarks>\n224\t    private static string InjectStatusOverlay(\n225\t        string html, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> nodeStatuses, bool includeRefresh)\n226\t    {\n227\t        // Same relaxed-encoder side-table treatment as taskFolderTargets: a JSON object (node id ->\n228\t        // status word) read back via textContent from a <script type=\"application/json\"> element.\n229\t        string statusesJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(nodeStatuses, new JsonSerializerOptions\n230\t        {\n231\t            Encoder = JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping,\n232\t        });\n233\t\n234\t        // Auto-reload tag (during-run only) right after the viewport meta in <head>.\n235\t        if (includeRefresh)\n236\t        {\n237\t            html = html.Replace(\n238\t                \"<meta name=\\\"viewport\\\" content=\\\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\\\">\",\n239\t                \"<meta name=\\\"viewport\\\" content=\\\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\\\">\\n\"\n240\t                    + \"<meta http-equiv=\\\"refresh\\\" content=\\\"2\\\">\",\n241\t                StringComparison.Ordinal);\n242\t        }\n243\t\n244\t        // Status-badge CSS (spinner @keyframes + per-status colours) just before </style>.\n245\t        html = html.Replace(\n246\t            \"</style>\", StatusOverlayStyle + \"\\n</style>\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n247\t\n248\t        // The node id -> status side-table, mirroring the task-folder-targets side-table, placed just\n249\t        // before the svg-pan-zoom script so it is already in the DOM when the module script reads it.\n250\t        html = html.Replace(\n251\t            \"<script src=\\\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/svg-pan-zoom\",\n252\t            \"<script type=\\\"application/json\\\" id=\\\"node-statuses\\\">\" + statusesJson + \"</script>\\n\"\n253\t                + \"<script src=\\\"https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/svg-pan-zoom\",\n254\t            StringComparison.Ordinal);\n255\t\n256\t        // The overlay functions, defined just before `let pz = null;` (module scope, after the graph/\n257\t        // targets consts, so they can read #node-statuses and be called from the try block below).\n258\t        html = html.Replace(\n259\t            \"let pz = null;\", StatusOverlayScript + \"\\n\\nlet pz = null;\", StringComparison.Ordinal);\n260\t\n261\t        // Build the overlay on the SAME SVG mermaid.render just produced, right after the title-band\n262\t        // overlay (so it measures the SVG in its final, wrap-corrected shape).\n263\t        html = html.Replace(\n264\t            \"  addTaskContainerOverlays(el);\",\n265\t viewport pans or zooms.\n269\t        html = html.Replace(\n270\t            \"minZoom: 0.1, maxZoom: 20, zoomScaleSensitivity: 0.3 });\",\n271\t            \"minZoom: 0.1, maxZoom: 20, zoomScaleSensitivity: 0.3,\\n\"\n272\t                + \"                        onPan: positionStatusBadges, onZoom: positionStatusBadges });\",\n273\t window.addEventListener('resize', () => { pz.resize(); pz.fit(); pz.center(); });\",\n278\t            \"  window.addEventListener('resize', () => { pz.resize(); pz.fit(); pz.center();
